basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old dance enthusiast and tech hobbyist living in Los Angeles, CA. I work as a software developer by day and spend my evenings honing my skills on Dance Dance Revolution and Stepmania. I have a particular interest in rhythm games and love customizing my setup to get the most out of my home gaming experience. When I'm not dancing, I enjoy exploring Armenian culture and history, often sharing insights and discoveries on Reddit. My online hours typically span from 8 PM to midnight PST during weekdays, with more flexible hours on weekends. I'm currently single, enjoying the freedom to travel and participate in DDR tournaments whenever possible.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having graduated with a degree in Software Engineering from UCLA. My expertise in rhythm games comes from years of dedicated practice and participation in online communities. I've also self-taught myself how to modify and create custom Stepmania charts, which has deepened my understanding of game mechanics.
